verdict.rationale: Snowflake documents a SQL API, a REST API for submitting SQL statements, checking their execution status and cancelling them, to access and update data (snowflake-docs-66, snowflake-docs-73, snowflake-docs-90). Its managed MCP server lets AI agents retrieve data and serves SQL executions as tools (snowflake-docs-14, snowflake-docs-57), with queries governed by role-based access control (snowflake-docs-8), so an agent can query and get results with no dashboard involved. The official CLI is documented, but the cited material describes it for managing apps rather than ad-hoc querying (snowflake-docs-1, snowflake-docs-86, snowflake-probe-4). Missing for 10: explicit authentication mechanics for agents (keys/OAuth/tokens), explicit schema-discovery and result-retrieval docs, CLI SQL-query workflow evidence, and independent or hands-on corroboration of an agent running end to end.
